automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Step Classification Rule for Test Setup and Initialization

These steps SHALL NOT appear in the main test method body but MUST be executed in test preconditions. The correlation mapping MUST explicitly state 'handled in test preconditions or setup' to distinguish from explicit test actions.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Intermediary Step Breakdown Requirement for Implicit Steps
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All implicit steps classified under ASR-001 and ASR-002
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: Every implicit step MUST be decomposed into 4-5 granular intermediary steps that detail the complete automation workflow. Each intermediary step MUST follow the format '[Step N] <detailed action description>' where N is sequential. The breakdown MUST include: (1) precondition verification or framework initialization, (2) element location strategy specification, (3) explicit wait condition application, (4) action execution, and (5) post-action state validation. This ensures complete traceability and reproducibility of implicit automation logic.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Direct Script Mapping Rule for Explicit Test Actions
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that represent the core test scenario actions (steps 5-7)
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: When a test step represents an explicit action within the test scenario focus, it MUST be mapped directly to a page object method call using the pattern 'self.<page_object_instance>.<method_name>()'. The method name MUST be descriptive and follow snake_case naming convention. Each direct mapping MUST correspond to exactly one test step unless the step requires multiple sequential method calls. The page object instance name MUST reflect the application module or screen being automated.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Assertion-Based Validation Rule for Verification Steps
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that verify expected outcomes, results, or UI states
automation_scripts_rules.rule_definition: When a test step requires verification of application state, UI element presence, or expected behavior, it MUST be implemented using assertion statements with the pattern 'assert self.<page_object_instance>.<verification_method>()'. The verification method MUST return a boolean value indicating success or failure. The method name MUST clearly indicate what is being verified using the prefix 'verify_' followed by the element or condition being validated. Assertions MUST fail the test immediately upon false return value.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Supporting Step Documentation Rule for Expected Results

This mapping serves as inline documentation explaining the test objective. The automation script line MUST duplicate the verification assertion used in the corresponding verification step to maintain consistency. This rule ensures that test purpose is explicitly documented within the automation correlation mapping.

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-One Mapping Enforcement Rule

One-to-one mapping ensures clear traceability between manual test cases and automated scripts. The correlation array MUST maintain sequential order matching the test step numbering without gaps or duplications.

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Intermediary Step Expansion Rule
